title: Mono (drawing)
description: Black ink on white: the house textures and symbols without colour, in the spirit of ISO 11091 landscape drawings and the black-and-white column of the PlanZV. For tender drawings, copies and faxes, and for checking that a map reads without colour.
source: ISO 11091:1994 (DIN EN ISO 11091:1999-10) conventions; PlanZV § 2 (colour and black-and-white equally valid)
evidence: Design derived from the conventions; no colours are prescribed there.
